newsitem.title: USA: Dave & Buster's sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Dave & Buster's sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Dave & Buster's Inc said Thursday its board declared a three-for-two split in the form of a stock dividend.
The company said it expected to distribute the stock dividend September 15 to shareholders of record on August 25.
Dave & Buster's, which currently operates 10 domestic restaurant and entertainment complexes, said it would add two domestic locations this year.
The company's stock traded unchanged at 31-7/8 Thursday morning.
